en: These graves were preordained for my servants and ministers, but so despised was I that none were actually buried with me, and all lay empty. The angry spirits in this place were drawn here from afar by my grief, and you have my blessing to take from here whatever suits you.

Thinking they had escaped my notice, my Lord Husband and my prime minister conspired to ease his suffering. This was treason, but I feigned ignorance and allowed them to work in secrecy, so I know not what they planned.
To stand above his own grave is, I think, something a man was never meant to do.
WEHT

When my reign over this island came to an end, I was much despised by my subjects, and I was buried here without ceremony. Your gesture, however small, is the first shred of dignity I have been offered since long before my death, and it is enough to grant me proper rest. Thank you.

When my subjects began to demand I be punished, my cousin volunteered to suffer as my proxy, as is the law of Orcs. He went dutifully to Blackspire Oubliette in the Blackglass Sprawl, where he should have perished, forgotten.
When we came here, we were all so happy. How did everything turn out so wrong?
Alright boys, enough chatter! Fuck 'em up!
Pretty place, ain't it? You should be pleased that we picked out such a nice burial plot for you.
Well, lookie here. A batch of right pretty ones, you are.
... what do you want?
... whatever you wish, Alpha.
...as you wish.
A bit of an overreaction, wouldn't you say? He barely said anything.
And who could blame him, really? Lass, you're showing more thigh than the butcher on market day.
Anyway, I've been thinking about it a lot lately because...
As you say.
At least he can still have feelings like that. I don't even remember what it's like.
Bite you? Son, it doesn't work like that. It... would take too long to explain, but you can't become a werewolf by being bit by one. That's just stupid superstition.
Call me a
Compared to what I wanted to do, that was gentle. Back way off, beardy.
Cry me a river. Oh what's that? Can't cry either? Try shutting up then. You can still do that, right?
Do not be afraid. You are not an enemy. Not yet.
Don't toy with me, fool. I can smell the stink of Frico's blood on you already.
Don't you tell me how to dress, you old shit pirate! He has no right to look, no matter what I wear!
Excuse me, but I'm not really in the mood to chat with strangers. Please leave me be.
Girl, you're crazy. That guy was cute!
Go to hell.
Good. Leave.
Grant!
Grant, my boy. You've done a great service for all of us. I am very proud of you.
Hah! You plan to march into the vampire lord's castle and murder him upon his throne? Oh, that would be a sight to see! I salivate at the thought of it.
Halfway there, Kirilo. Drop it.

Haven't seen you around here before, strangers. This is Hayill. If you've come lookin' for trouble, you'll find more of it than you care for. If not, we welcome you and your coin. Just watch yourselves.
He has grown powerful through the advantage that pass affords him, taxing those he deems useful and bleeding those he does not. How do you intend to deal with him?
He is... brief, but even fat as he is, he is powerful. You will not be disappointed.
He's been dropping hints that he wants to lay with me though. I pretend to be too dumb to notice. I ain't a poofter.
Head over to the store if you need any supplies. I'm sure he'll be glad to see your coin.
Hey. You're from out of town, right? You seen many women on the island?
I appreciate your help, but if you don't mind, we could use some privacy. We've got a lot to talk about.
I didn't think so. There's even less women here than there were back home in Tsarath, and that's saying something.
I expect you to return with blood under your claws and stories under your tongue.
I feel kinda bad for the guy, honestly.
I feel much better now. Thanks again.
I feel rather bad for him. He must've thought he spied a fallen angel just now.

I guess compared to the brand and the exile, it's a stupid detail to get hung up on. 
I'm gonna go talk to him. Thanks for listening.
I have decided that you shall serve as our emissary instead. Lead them to the mountain, slaughter that leech upon it, and piss on everything he owns.
I have given you all the help I dare. Go, and remember my generosity.
I have no idea what just happened.
I heard you talking earlier, you know. I should probably be mad, but it's hard for me to feel upset right now. Thank you.
I just guard the door, stranger. If you need something else, you'll have to find someone more important to ask.
I kill my enemies, Rangda. I don't go out of my way to make more of them. There is a difference.
I see. Well, you'll find Hayill a pleasant enough place if you mind yourselves. Visit our shop and tavern, if you need supplies. Good day.
I suppose your leech can stay, for the time being, as a show of goodwill.
I understand you have killed Frico! This is excellent news!
I was talking about you nursing your frivolous pride, woman. Next time, ignore it and keep your braying to yourself.
I will.
I wonder if the barkeep will bother putting his shirt on today.
I'd like to actually hear you shut your mouth right about now.
I'm just the Alpha's bodyguard. You don't need to talk to me.
I'm sure they weren't orc women, not that I'd get picky over a human right about now.
I'm the scum of the earth, and even I think you're a bitch.
I'm... ashamed that I ever bought this. I don't think I'd have had the heart to use it anyway. It was expensive though, so... take it. Maybe you can sell it.
I've been thinking about it though, and... even if I did find a woman on this island, why would she care about me? Not like any other woman ever did.
If we're really never going to get out of here, then... I'm pretty damn lucky to have a friend in this at all.
If you hurt our town, you will suffer.
In truth, that foppish corpse has been a nuisance to us for quite some time, but my people are not fighters, and I would not throw them at him in suicidal defiance.
It's a lot easier to keep control of ourselves when we aren't forced to hide what we are. Getting sent here was the best thing that ever happened to me.
It's been awful lonely, and he has been real good to me. I don't know. What do you think?
It's clear I don't need a bodyguard. You've grown fat from a lack of any real work to do.
Just leave me alone.
Just try it, hamshanks!
Let me be entirely unsubtle. Get out of my town.
Let us not waste time with such idle distractions.
Like I care what you think, fatass.
Like hell! I know where that compliment was going.
Maybe I will!
Mind your business while you're here, and you'll have no trouble from us.
Mouth off like that to one of my brothers again and you'll see where my boot is going.
My favorite part was how you could actually see the wound forming on his soul. Real nice, Rangda. Classy broad, you.
My patience is wearing thin, leech-lover. Begone!
No shirt, no shorts, no problem. Come on in.
Nobody asked you. Mind your damn business.
Now go.
Oh goodness. That poor fellow. I think I actually heard his heart breaking.
Shit, Rangda, that was cold. You could've at least let him down gently.
Shit, is that all it takes? Remind me not to get on your bad side.
Shut up, Shapiro.
Shut your mouth, you old fossil. He has no right to gawk at me.
T'was just a look then, wasn't it? But fine, suit yourself.
Take care of Grant for us. The Alpha would never admit it, but he cares deeply for that boy, and he would be devastated if anything were to happen to him.
Take your sermon and stuff it, priest.
Tell Grant that I am proud of him.
Thank you, Alpha.
That guy over there, he's a good friend of mine. We've watched each others' backs since shipping up here, and there's nobody I trust more.
That was a shit thing to do, Rangda. He's a good guy, and he was just trying to pay you a compliment.
That's rich coming from a murderer.
The people here don't really seem all that happy.
Then why do you feel compelled to offer your inane commentary? Nobody cares what you think, Goblin.
Then, you'll be needing a good deal of money, and no small share of luck. I'm afraid, however, that I can help you with neither. Good day.
There is only one path to go further east, and it is controlled by the vampire lord, Frico.
There's no sense wasting time on the problems of every random passer-by, after all.
This island is a prison, you idiot. Nobody's supposed to be happy.
Ugh, sorry. I shouldn't use strangers for sounding boards. Forget it.
Ugh. Drop dead, asshole. I don't care how long it's been since you've seen a healthy orc woman, I don't want anything to do with you.
Very well. You have earned the right to choose this. Go with my blessing.
We couldn't have made a better go at starting our own community if we had tried. Here there's no law, and there were already ruined towns just waiting for us.
Welcome to Hayill, stranger. Is there something I can do for you?
Welcome to Hayill. Yes, we're all werewolves. Play nice and you're good, fuck with us and we kill you. Simple, right?
Who asked you, anyway? Mind your own business.
Why the hell should I care?
Yeah, I'm sure that he wouldn't want me to agree just to humour him. Thanks for listening.
Yeah. Alright. Sorry, miss.
Yeah? Well why don't you fuck him then.
Yeah? Why don't you go let him flirt with you then?
Yes, Alpha.
Yes, exactly.
Yes, for a time at least. I will return when I am ready.
You enjoyed hurting him. I've seen you treat our enemies with more dignity.
You have some brass if nothing else. I would very much like to see Frico brought down by your hands. Perhaps I can support you in this.
You have the scent of the road heavy on you now, and I do not see you returning with your belongings. You intend to remain with your new companions then?
You know Rangda, patience is a virtue. You have no idea what he's been through, and he was terribly polite.
You must have come a long way. There are smells on you I don't recognize.
You should speak with the Alpha if you haven't already. He is well-connected, and may be able to help you.
You suppose there are any other orc women on the island at all, or are you really the only one?
You! You're a woman! I ain't seen a woman in forever! I... um... you haven't by any chance seen other women around the island, have you?
You... um... you are awful strong-looking, miss. That armour... I mean it looks amazing on you.
again and I'll wound more than your soul.
Evening, gents. Why not take a seat and rest a spell.
Hedgefort Gardens Cafe - Open!
Hedgefort Maze - Open to all visitors.
I can't sell 'em any lower than that.

I feel bad, though... most of the grass
has worn out along the route I usually take.
I'll need to close up soon before it gets too dark, but I've still got one last platter of sandwiches here.
I'm not going to ask any questions, though. They just seem to want to relax and, so long as there's no nonsense, I've got nothing against them being here.
I've been back and forth through the maze so many times, but it never seems to get old.
I've been getting some... interesting customers, to say the least. Nearly had a heart attack when that skeleton walked up to the counter.
Thanks!

That's three of my best toasted sandwiches for 125$.
How does that sound?
These egg and cress sandwiches are simply divine. I must ask that fellow over there for the recipe.

When I get home, I shall write a book about this place...
if I ever do get home.
You were right, there was a problem with the steam pressure. Looks like I owe you a drink. We've had the leak plugged up, so you shouldn't have any trouble getting the doors open.
A beast. No doubt a large one. Keep your eyes peeled.
A common thug, running from his own inadequacy. Best ignore him.
Aaah! Run away!!
Ah, you don't... you don't suppose maybe we could find another way through? Do we really have to go in the direction of the howling and screaming?
As entertaining as that was, this pass is probably dangerous. Keep your eyes open.
Beware of Falling Rocks
Bye! We'll just help ourselves to whatever you might've dropped back there, kay?
Goodness! Perhaps, maybe we should find another way 'round?
Hah! Was that our ambush? What a joke.
He's probably running for a very good reason. Stay on-guard.
Hey! You forgot your ambush! Now how are you going to get all our money?
I guess he didn't want our coin badly enough to work for it. What do you suppose set him off?
I smelled sasquatch when I came through here before. Guess that guy found it.
I'd bet my cutlass that noise was a sasquatch. Usually not too aggressive, but that one sounds mightily set-off.
I'd know that sound anywhere. Sasquatch, for sure. Nothing we can't handle.
I'm not sure if I'm relieved, or more worried than before. Let's just be careful.
Oh, great. I wasn't looking forward to tomorrow anyway. Let's go directly toward the horrible thing, shall we?
Something up ahead seriously stinks. I'd wager it's also angry. Be careful.
That sound was a sasquatch. An irritated one. No wonder he was in such a hurry.
There's blood up ahead. Probably his friends got wasted and he's the only one who ran in time. Watch yourself.
Well, shall we see what got his panties into such a twist?
Well, so much for getting rich quick, huh? Why would someone even care about getting rich here anyway?
Whatever it is, I can handle it. Don't worry about it.
Exec. Suites
Yes, your discipline is bound within the myriad folds of this steel pearl. Go then, Crusader, with this symbol of the righteous, and scour this land!
You come seeking power, as did the demons, but the power guarded herein belongs only to those with the discipline to use it wisely.
This place gives me an uneasy feeling. If we must explore it, I would caution you to stay alert. Something unholy this way waits.
...unless you'd like to help with a little project of mine.
All five veins are present, to be sure, and they have not collapsed into the null-vein, but they are somehow... cancelling one another out?
Good morning! I just finished!
Great! Let's see!
I grew it myself. Look.
I have a feeling you have nothing to worry about!

I haven't touched the forge lately. I'm very busy working out the theory for my next attempt. It'll probably be a few months before I even know where to start with more materials. Thanks for checking in though.
I hope.
I love secrets! What's the project? A crown of unlimited power? A breastplate of invulnerability? I have some ideas for one of those.
I will take the time to double-check my alignments.
I'm honoured! Beyond honoured! This is really special. I won't even charge you for it.
I'm so glad to hear it! Are you by yourself? What brings you out to my forge today?
I'm sure you'll think of something!
I... I've finished. I can't believe that I've just done that. My experiment was a success, but...
It was my pleasure! Good luck!
It's an engagement gift.
It's fine, thanks. Very useful!
It's good to see you again! How's the ring working out?
It's yours, as promised, but I'm afraid I can't tell you how to make effective use of it. You may have to do some experimentation of your own. As for me...
Looks like someone's here to pick you up. Guess we didn't finish a moment too soon, hmm? Don't worry, my lips are sealed!

My interest in this is purely academic, so I propose this - if you bring me the necessary components to complete my experiment, I will give you the resulting item. If it works, you'll have all five veins of mana at once, and even if it doesn't work, you'll have a powerful and valuable piece.
Not as exciting for me, perhaps, but I'm sure it's exciting for you, and I do owe you one, so count me in! What did you have in mind?
Now I just need to figure out where and when to give it to him.
Of course not. Thank you again.
Oh, wow! Is that what I think it is? Where'd you find one of these?

Sounds good, right? Of course it does. In order to complete the project, I'll need a diamond, a ruby, a sapphire, an emerald, an onyx, and... oh, let's say a ring. Come find me when you have all of those things, and I will make for you a miracle.
That's very generous. I know you'll do it justice.
This is perfect. He's going to love it.
Travelers? Well, I don't have anything for you. Rest up in the yard if you need to, but best be moving on. Unless...
Very well. Make yourself comfortable, but leave me in peace. This will take several hours, and I must not be disturbed.

We've just made history! Nobody's ever accomplished such a thing before! I'll have to revise my method and figure out how to strengthen the braid. I've got a lot of work ahead of me, but I would not have come this far without your help. Take the ring with my thanks!
Well, I need a little favor. I need a smith, but this is kind of a secret, so I can't have the work done at my own camp. I was hoping you could help me out.

Well, I've figured out how to do it!  ... I think. Enchantments are a more permanent and controlled form of magic. It should be possible for me to braid all five veins of mana together into a single object. The problem is that the materials necessary for such an experiment are beyond my means.
Wow, working with that bezoar was really inspiring! I'm just bursting with ideas right now! I have to jot these down while they're still fresh. You don't mind if I excuse myself?

Yes, well I am an enchanter-smith, you see. You probably already know that there are five veins of mana, and it is practically impossible to use more than one at a time without their unique qualities simply collapsing into the null-vein, Arcus.
You actually went through that hellish ritual? And... then you thought to bring it to me?
You again. Remember, in order to make that ring, you'll need to bring me a diamond, a ruby, a sapphire, an emerald, an onyx, and the base ring.
You... you actually have them all! I am ready. Shall I begin?
This is the best I can do. I shall have to hope that this seal holds until someone comes along with enough strength to destroy those spirits once and for all.
Alright, I'm gone! Have fun with the purging and stuff!
Are you new? You can use the other bed if you want. We're all brothers and sisters here.
Assassins! Protect the master!
He's around here somewhere. He has black hair and the body of a self-absorbed patriarch. If you want the key to pass through to Lord Frico's castle, you'll go and kill Grae for me.
He's dead? Excellent! Here is your key as promised.
I'm not one of them, I swear! I just came here for the free sex!
